content: Label Scoring Layer: At this point, each word INLINEFORM0 is associated with a hidden representation of the word, INLINEFORM1 . In the label scoring layer, we use a fully connected neural network with one hidden layer to output a score associated with each of the 10 categories for each word. Let INLINEFORM2 and INLINEFORM3 . We can compute a vector of scores s = INLINEFORM4 where the ith component of s is the score of class i for a given word.
